aboutIntroTitle: A Los Angeles glass installer, focused on the details
aboutIntroCopy: LA Glass designs and installs custom shower enclosures, shower doors, glass railings, and architectural glass throughout the Los Angeles area.
servicesIntroCopy: LA Glass provides custom glass installation for residential and approved commercial projects across the Los Angeles area. Every project is built around precise measurements, clean installation, and dependable hardware.
galleryIntroCopy: Every image below is an actual LA Glass project. Category filters and a full lightbox view are coming as the gallery grows.
contactIntroCopy: Share the project type, city or ZIP code, and a few details. LA Glass will review the information and follow up about the next step.
contactAsideCopy: Call or text with your project details and LA Glass will get back to you. Estimates are always free.
privacyIntroCopy: The full LA Glass privacy policy is being prepared and will be published here after owner review.
privacyBody: In short: information you share when contacting LA Glass — such as your name, phone number, email, and project details — is used only to respond to your request and prepare your estimate. It is not sold or published.
privacyFootnote: Questions in the meantime? Reach out through the contact page.
